verdict.rationale: Token2's tools let users delete data stored on the key itself. fido2-manage documents deleting resident credentials (passkeys) and biometric templates, the companion app supports factory resets, and the TOTP toolset states all computation is local with no seed sent to a server. However, the evidence covers only on-device credential deletion and does not address retention controls or policies more broadly. Missing for 10: documented data-retention policy or controls, deletion of any vendor- or service-side data (e.g., the online demo or Entra enrollment logs), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
